2608.07437.title: Fisher-R1: Training LLM Agents for Reliable Hypothesis Testing
2608.07437.paper_summary: Reliable hypothesis testing is the foundation of many empirical scientific claims. Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly used to automate this process, as they can inspect datasets, generate code, and produce analyses end-to-end. However, we show that they frequently make subtle inferential errors that lead to incorrect conclusions despite correctly executed analyses. Existing benchmarks fail to capture this failure mode, as they rarely assess whether a reported p-value is statistically valid given the assumptions underlying the data. We address this gap by building P-Bench, a benchmark comprising 425 open-ended, realistic hypothesis-testing tasks spanning economics, biology, and medicine. Each task requires an agent to select a statistical method, compute a p-value, and draw a conclusion given only a scientific hypothesis and a dataset. We further introduce Fisher-R1, an open-weight LLM agent trained for rigorous hypothesis testing using synthetic tasks and reinforcement learning. On P-Bench, Fisher-R1-14B substantially improves over its backbone and outperforms strong proprietary and open-source baselines, including GPT-5.4 and DeepSeekV4-Pro, achieving a 21% average relative improvement in single-trial success over DeepSeek-V4-Pro, with gains up to 26% on the most challenging tasks. Our results demonstrate that current LLM agents lack reliable statistical reasoning for hypothesis testing and that reinforcement learning on tasks with verified statistical reward substantially improves reliability.
2608.07437.paper_summary_zh: 可靠的假設檢驗是許多實證科學主張的基礎。大型語言模型（LLM）代理越來越多地被用來自動化這一過程，因為它們可以檢查數據集、生成代碼並進行端到端的分析。<lb/>然而，我們顯示它們經常會出現微妙的推理錯誤，導致不正確的結論，即使分析執行正確。<lb/>現有的基準未能捕捉到這種失敗模式，因為它們很少評估報告的 p 值在數據的基本假設下是否統計有效。<lb/>我們通過建立 P-Bench 來填補這一空白，這是一個包含 425 個開放式、現實的假設檢驗任務的基準，涵蓋經濟學、生物學和醫學。<lb/>每個任務要求代理選擇一種統計方法，計算 p 值，並僅根據科學假設和數據集得出結論。<lb/>我們進一步介紹了 Fisher-R1，一個經過合成任務和強化學習訓練的開放權重 LLM 代理，用於嚴格的假設檢驗。<lb/>在 P-Bench 上，Fisher-R1-14B 顯著改善了其基礎模型，並超越了強大的專有和開源基準，包括 GPT-5.4 和 DeepSeekV4-Pro，在單次試驗成功率上相對於 DeepSeek-V4-Pro 提高了 21%，在最具挑戰性的任務上增幅高達 26%。<lb/>我們的結果表明，目前的 LLM 代理在假設檢驗方面缺乏可靠的統計推理，並且在經過驗證的統計獎勵任務上進行強化學習顯著提高了可靠性。
